how: Recruitment invited pixel placement and additional hands while an incoming movement promised to grow the shared mark.
Neutrality depended on becoming big enough and participants later described the work as achieved with limited resources.
Canvas lettering was intended to recruit members back into the room, although the membership milestone does not establish that the lettering caused growth.
Heart, banner, lettering, Greybow naming, and new-section designs supplied recognizable forms for the shared mark.
Members reported the subreddit name written and Pusheen finished rather than leaving construction wholly at the level of proposals.
Route instructions directed builders under a landmark and around a shared road.
A participant proposed an embedded heart and later announced that its movement would help grow the blob.
Later proposing and joining are visible, but the first invitation does not identify the original starter or establish a starter causing the opening recruitment call.
This room occupies the decided-order minority through official strategy, delegation, and referral to moderators, without demonstrating command over every placement.
An official strategy establishes claimed direction, while reported failure prevents equating that claim with effective control.
Official album jokes furnished the event group with shared material outside the model element concerning the pixel mark itself.
A participant explicitly described the achievement as unscripted, which supports reported nonuse for that work without establishing universal nonuse of machines or spare accounts.
Participants valued small unscripted struggle as more enjoyable and meaningful than joining a larger faction using bots.
Short replies promised help, including a conditional promise when capacity permitted.
Acceptance can include an availability explanation and defer help, so a reasoned response cannot be treated as a refusal merely because it is not bare.
Repeated defense calls and repair reports concern both the grey area and the Pusheen rebuilt after relocation.
Maintenance strain need not produce automation when participants persist manually and value an achievement explicitly reported as unscripted.
Treaty proposals, a declared ceasefire, a reported agreement, and an ongoing truce list organize relations with neighbours.
Instructions spare a neighbouring flag, disavow invasion, and move the Greybow on request.
A reported truce explicitly informs the next expansion instructions, connecting agreement to restraint without proving compliance by every placer.
Border negotiation can accompany anticipation of expansion rather than await completed erosion, while this coded sequence does not establish which repair caused a particular treaty.
Help is requested, promised, and welcomed across neighbours, including offers made while the room itself remains under attack.
Mutual protection and named allies fit the coalition element at its smallest range without establishing a joint governing body.
Permission to build around a shared road and a question about obtaining permission support locally constrained hosting rather than unconstrained relocation.
A member undertakes to relay an outside offer to moderators, although the resulting exchange is not recorded in the concept.
Members seek new bases, prefer relocation to vengeance, and revise the destination toward a road and later space opened by the Void.
Proposed relocation is followed by evaluation of failure and another site proposal, so attempts and established new homes must remain distinguishable.
Relocation reopens design and reported construction, requiring a return from the move to building rather than ending the organizing sequence there.
Reported completion of the rebuilt Pusheen is followed by another defense call, renewing upkeep at the replacement work.
A truce list and moderator referral establish agreements and channels, but no coded concept establishes a dispute over who may bind the room.
The concepts do not show an agreement producing an authority dispute, and referral to moderators alone does not establish that mechanism.
Spreading grey and grounding an alliance in shared greyness instantiate the colour-affiliation branch without requiring a documented body predating the canvas.
The empty preweek brief and canvas-specific concepts cannot determine whether members carried an earlier quarrel into this event.
A canvas threat and an outsider chant do not establish an earlier tie naming a GreyBlob attack target, and the supplied history cannot settle that claim.
The album joke does not establish an April Fools host takeover or a convention treating canvas calls as fake.
An event-focused invitation and birthday do not document a parent-room flood, rule change, or the act of opening a dedicated canvas room.
The coded record does not expose the host boundary decision needed to test whether recruitment flooded a parent venue and caused a separate room.
Members celebrate a reported final cat, thank contributors, describe limited-resource achievement, and take pride in a last pixel.
Participants save a screenshot, mourn the original spot, request a better image, and answer with a crop.
Members consider keeping the group together beyond the event and attempt successor building, while promised later help remains unverified.
Carrying the group to another canvas can begin during the original event rather than requiring its closure.
A final record is not a necessary precursor to successor activity because a parallel canvas appears before closure, and later preservation does not establish causation.
Choosing a successor involves comparing timer enjoyment, traffic, access, and technical usability before committing to a shared setting.
A preferred desktop image and correction distinguishing two cats do not establish a dispute over an authoritative archive or a shared cleanup.
The chant carries a canvas contest into the room through an outsider's post.
The host room can be the venue and target of contention while an outsider is the actor, so the chant cannot be attributed to its members.
Calls to take checkerboard and lightly maintained grey instantiate the encroachment range without proving a coordinated raid or an inherited enemy.
